spans.s: DAṂS, only cs. daṃsáya, be wondrous.
dáṃṣ-ṭra, m., ā, f. tusk, fang.

daṃṣṭr-in, a. possessed of fangs;
 🞄m. animal with fangs, beast of prey.
daṃs-ána, n., ā, f. wondrous deed, 🞄power, or skill.
dáṃs-u, a. of wondrous power (—˚): -patnī, f. having a lord of wondrous power.
dánu, f. N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and 🞄the mother of the Dānavas.
1. dā́nu, m. f. kind of demon.

2. dā́nu, f. n. drop;
 dew.

danu-kabandha, m. N. of a demon;
 🞄-ja, m. a Dānava.
dánt, m. (strong base of dát, only nm. 🞄dan) tooth.

1. dā-n-ta, pp. √ dam;
 m. N. of a brother 🞄of Damayantī.
2. dānta, a. made of ivory (danta).
3. dā‿anta, a. ending in -dā.
danta‿agra, n. point of a tooth.
dantā-danti, ad. tooth against 🞄tooth = tooth and nail (of combatants).
dantā-vala, m. elephant.
dantura-ya, den. P. stud or fill with: 🞄pp. danturita, studded with, full of (—˚).

danta‿ulūkhal-ika, a. using 🞄his teeth as a pestle;
 -ulūkhalin, a. id..

dant-ya, a. dental (letter);
 good for 🞄the teeth.

dan-daś-ū́ka, a. mordacious;
 m. 🞄kind of snake.
dáṃ-pati, m. master of the house: du. 🞄master and mistress, man and wife, pair, couple.
3. dā‿ana, n. [√ 2. dā] fragrant secretion 🞄from the temples of elephants in rut, 🞄temple-juice.
dā́na-vat, a. abounding in gifts, 🞄liberal.
dānava-pati, m. lord of the Dānavas, 🞄Rāhu.
dāna-vaśī-kṛ, bribe with gifts.
dāná‿apnas, a. abounding in gifts.
dāṃpatya, n. wedlock (fr. daṃpati).
